name: Naha (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with a white ring enclosing three comma-forms.
history: The flag of Naha bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Naha municipal emblem — a white ring enclosing three comma-forms
features.symbolism: echoing the hidari-gomon, the triple-comma crest of the Ryukyu kings
